mapper.select: SELECT PROD.FINPROD_ID as prodid, NVL(PROD.FINPROD_ABBR,PROD.FINPROD_NAME) prodname, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(PROD.ACTMDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') < #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN '已到期' ELSE CASE WHEN D.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(D.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN '已到期' ELSE '运作中' END END status, C.JX as interestAmount, C.XJ as cashBalance FROM ( SELECT B.BOOKSET_ID, B.BALANCE_DATE, B.JX, B.XJ, row_number() over (PARTITION BY B.BOOKSET_ID ORDER BY B.BALANCE_DATE DESC) as newResult FROM ( SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BALANCE_DATE, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_NO like '12040101%' THEN A.O_AMT ELSE 0 END) JX, SUM(CASE WHEN A.SUBJECT_NO like '10020101%' THEN A.O_AMT ELSE 0 END) XJ FROM BOK_BALANCE A GROUP BY A.BOOKSET_ID,A.BALANCE_DATE ) B WHERE (B.JX != 0 OR B.XJ != 0) AND TO_CHAR(B.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') < #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.BOOKSET_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN T.SUBJECT_NO like '40010101%' AND T.O_AMT = 0 THEN T.BALANCE_DATE ELSE NULL END) MDATE FROM BOK_BALANCE T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{queryEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.BOOKSET_ID ) D ON C.BOOKSET_ID = D.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BOK ON C.BOOKSET_ID = BOK.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON PROD.FINPROD_ID = BOK.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND PROD.FINPROD_TYPE = BOK.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE WHERE C.newResult = 1 AND PROD.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL
